node.title: From Field Practice to Pre-Standardization: An Extensible Case-Study Framework
node.reading: Field systems are a valuable source of architectural knowledge, but their details rarely transfer unchanged to another sector or to a standards group. Conversely, a standards discussion can become too abstract to expose whether proposed requirements survive real operating conditions. This paper proposes a deliberately small, boundedly extensible case-study framework for crossing that gap. A documented operating system is examined for its actors, constraints, decisions, interventions and evidence; these are distilled into a minimum case; the case is extended only while its core distinctions remain intact; and stable case facts become a common surface for technical challenges . Each challenge is traced to a group's Terms of Reference (ToR) and then developed into use cases, tests and evidence obligations by the relevant working groups or work packages. The resulting findings return to field design and deployment. The accompanying annex shows how the publicly available Delegated Authority OS under Context Change package applies this framework to FG-TIDA. It is an example of pre-standardization working material, not an adopted ITU model or a validated implementation.

relations: A bounded case-study method could extract one testable interoperability problem from the broader architectural-translation engagement.
El caso comercial no demuestra que se presentara ese challenge ni que una norma lo aceptara. La extracción debe conservar la restricción que causa el fallo.
The deployed substrate can define a bounded research task without turning that task into a model of the entire operating system.
El modelo mínimo no representa la totalidad del sistema desplegado ni su rendimiento global.
Operational capture and capability analysis can define a bounded research case while preserving the context that the minimum model deliberately leaves outside.
El proyecto entero no queda validado por el caso mínimo ni el caso mínimo representa toda la organización.
The case-study framework can preserve the field observation as evidence while recording the migration interpretation as a separate, testable layer with its own data requirements.
La codificación no equivale a validación independiente ni a adopción de una contribución por un organismo de estándares.
The extensible case-study method could translate a frontier observation into a bounded requirement and test, rather than treating experience itself as a standard.
Propuesta de elaboración. Participación, entrega y publicación no acreditan adopción o respaldo de un organismo.
The bounded-oracle design makes a case-study test inspectable by separating referee knowledge, candidate observations and the declared failure condition.
El diseño no es una ejecución nueva ni demuestra por sí mismo un resultado DDS A, B o C.
